records.source_statement: Lilly interprets one-degree closeness of Mars and seventh ruler/Moon as a hypothetical person in the household.
limitations: Angular and sign conditions, not actual household observation.

records.source_statement: Separation from Mars is used as a sign a previous attachment might have ceased.
Jupiter or Saturn in specified source combinations is taken to indicate a socially prominent or older third person.
limitations: Social stereotypes are not factual biographical data.

records.source_statement: Mercury joining seventh ruler or Moon is interpreted as a clerk, merchant or agile younger person.
